thread.title: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners
thread.title_full: Shannon Everett: American Truckers Have to Compete with Foreigners

author: Claw Hammer
text: The insurance industry controls the trucking industry. Many, many of the larger carriers are subsidized by the gov to hire foreigners, whether or not they can speak English or understand the 'rules of the road' is irrelevant. It's a HUGE problem. As someone with over 2 million safe driving miles all over the USA hauling concert stages, theatrical productions and everything in between when I wasn't on tour, I finally threw in the towel a couple years ago. I knew many drivers with lots of experience who've said enough is enough and quit the industry because of the nonsense and non-English speaking foreigners who don't have a clue but yet have some kind of CDL allowing them to drive a rig. Most have ZERO common sense, drive like they're driving in their own country and ZERO professionalism or common courtesy. Taking a shower for many of them means splashing on more gas station cologne is all & maybe changing their sandals. The industry is a cesspool controlled by insurance companies and dominated now by foreign managed companies with foreign drivers from dozens of different countries who have very little knowledge of anything safety related and are just downright scary to share the road with 😳. Trucking is a dumpster fire and with good reason why nobody wants to drive an 18-wheeler anymore except under-qualified foreigners , and those who have no other option to put food on the table for their family. It used to be a noble profession in the 80s-90s, not anymore. Those days are long ago in the rear view mirror now thanks to the gov lowering the barrier to entry and opening the floodgates to seriously under-qualified foreign drivers with subsidies and low interest loans 😡.
